page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by 32 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core allocation. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the bottom 25%, with single-threaded gzip compression performing in the bottom 10%. However, the 32 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached large blocks remains in the average tier, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is classified as compute-optimized. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for parallelizable workloads that can leverage all 32 dedicated cores without requiring high memory-per-core ratios or local storage. Suitable workloads include multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, Redis operations, and moderate LLM inference tasks using small to medium models, whereas single-threaded applications or memory-heavy databases may experience performance bottlenecks.
